title: ir.governance.policy.promoted
description: Decision R3: distinct from the Adaptive FRD's ir.routing.policy.promoted (that one is the learned SELECTION policy). This event is the signed, human-promoted governance policy -- classes, eligibility, tiering, tightening map, bands. Sidecars converge to `version` and revoke bindings issued under the previous version.

approver.description: The Domain Authority's identity (FR-IRG-KEY-01: signing requires their own hardware token).
